profile.headline: Software & Cloud Architect – Senior Software Engineer
profile.jobTitle: Software & Cloud Architect – Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
My career has evolved through several architectural disciplines that have turned out to complement each other more than I expected. As a Software Architect, I defined patterns and reusable, generic components. As a Data Architect, I designed data structures, ETL pipelines, and data modelling processes across Big Data ecosystems. As a Cloud Architect, I designed cloud-native components, services, and their end-to-end relationships on AWS. All of it was held together by CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code, and grounded by hands-on front-end and backend delivery.
What ties these together is Enterprise Architecture: aligning application, data, technology, and business architecture so IT decisions serve long-term business strategy rather than short-term convenience. A clear example is the integration platform I lead for Amazon Same-Day Delivery, Walmart GoLocal, and Narvar, one reusable, event-driven platform designed around contract-first integration, shared observability, and the omnichannel fulfilment strategy driving the business.
I'm committed to test-driven, production-grade engineering, bridging the gap between cloud strategy, software development, and business outcomes.

positions.title: Software & Cloud Architect – Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architect and deliver scalable cloud-native backend systems, AWS infrastructure, and AI-powered solutions for enterprise clients (like The Motley Fool and CSC Generation/Sur La Table) and other medium-sized businesses across e-commerce, logistics, and fintech sectors through consulting engagements. 

    - Architected and delivered secure, scalable cloud-native backend systems and AI-powered solutions on Amazon Web Services (AWS) for enterprise clients (including The Motley Fool and CSC Generation/Sur La Table) across e-commerce, logistics, and fintech sectors.
    - Designed and built distributed microservices and API ecosystems utilizing Python, FastAPI, Django, and Flask, ensuring high availability and low-latency performance under production loads.
    - Engineered production-grade Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) modules using Terraform to provision reliable, repeatable cloud infrastructure, significantly enhancing deployment consistency.
    - Optimized and managed CI/CD pipelines to streamline deployment lifecycles, accelerate release velocity, and mitigate regression risks across client environments.
    - Designed robust Kappa and Lambda data architectures alongside complex ETL pipelines, facilitating seamless data integration across third-party enterprise platforms.
    - Spearheaded technical architecture decisions, infrastructure modernization roadmaps, and cloud cost/performance optimization initiatives for key client engagements.
    - Provided technical leadership and mentorship to cross-functional engineering teams, establishing rigorous best practices in cloud architecture, system design, and DevOps workflows.

positions.title: Cloud Architect & Backend
positions.description:
Architecting and implementing scalable AWS-native systems to support the full lifecycle of AI-based prototypes, from development to production-ready automation. Leveraging Python and Terraform to integrate internal tools, manage cloud infrastructure, and accelerate delivery.

    - AI Systems Architecture: Architected and implemented scalable AWS-native systems to support the full lifecycle of AI-based prototypes, transitioning experimental models into production-ready AI-powered inference products.
    - Internal Developer Platform (IDP): Reduced service bootstrapping time significantly by managing core infrastructure as an internal product, providing pre-configured, compliant CI/CD and IaC scaffolding for engineering teams.
    - Engineering Enablement: Designed and implemented reusable software interfaces and core components to eliminate systemic technical debt, enabling the reliable promotion of AI-driven products into production environments.
    - Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Applied rigorous IaC principles using Terraform to automate infrastructure provisioning across environments in a secure, reliable, and scalable way, accelerating overall delivery speed.
    - Technical Mentorship: Mentored engineers on AWS best practices, software design principles, and cloud-native development patterns, raising technical standards and fostering a culture of engineering excellence across the team.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Solution Architecture · Python · Terraform · CICD

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead architect and technical leader for microservices and backend systems on AWS, spanning API development, ETL pipelines, third-party integrations, and cloud infrastructure. Drove infrastructure assessments and implemented improvements using Terraform and CI/CD pipelines to increase deployment reliability and reduce delivery friction.

    - Designed and built a reusable, event-driven partner integration platform (AWS SNS/SQS, contract-first schemas, shared observability) that became the standard onboarding path for delivery and logistics partners.
    - Used that platform to architect the integration with Amazon Same-Day Delivery, enabling retail stores to offer same-day fulfilment through a high-availability e-commerce platform.
    - Reused the same platform to deliver Walmart GoLocal, expanding last-mile delivery options for retail customers and reducing fulfilment gaps.
    - Extended the platform to connect with Narvar, supporting post-purchase returns and exchanges and streamlining reverse logistics operations.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Big Data · Terraform · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · FastAPI · Django · PostgreSQL · Flask · Microservices

positions.title: Data Architect & Software Designer
positions.description:
Core member of Plastiq's Data Engineering team, responsible for designing and operating a scalable Lambda Architecture on AWS and GCP to ingest and transform data from a wide ecosystem of platforms, including Bing Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Zendesk, Visa, Mastercard, Stripe, Salesforce, Google Analytics, and Optimizely.

    - Architected and managed a Snowflake-based data warehouse, enforcing data governance and full compliance with PCI-DSS and PII protection standards.
    - Built and maintained backend microservices on AWS to synchronise data across the warehouse, relational databases, third-party integrations, and internal systems.
    - Developed APIs for report generation, data aggregation, real-time monitoring, and automated email reporting pipelines.
    - Implemented data encryption and cryptographic key rotation processes to harden security across the data platform.
    - Applied Big Data technologies at scale, including Elasticsearch, Snowflake, and the Apache Spark ecosystem.
    - Served as a hiring gatekeeper for the data engineering team, designing and conducting technical interviews to evaluate and select candidates.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Delivered backend, cloud, and AI-driven solutions across two high-impact client engagements.

National Geographic
Built and refactored applications to achieve GDPR compliance across EU and US markets, developing secure RESTful APIs and microservices in Django and Flask. Used Apigee for API security and traffic monitoring, and managed cloud infrastructure on AWS with Terraform and Docker for scalable, maintainable deployments.

Autobuses de Oriente
Contributed to a real-time video processing platform focused on facial analysis, delivering scalable AI components using Google Cloud Platform and TensorFlow for advanced video analytics.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Brought in to lead the final delivery phase of a custom Odoo application, managing an internal team and a third-party vendor simultaneously to hit release on time with quality standards intact.
    - Directed a cross-functional team and provided technical oversight to an external vendor, ensuring consistent code quality across both streams.
    - Delivered new features and resolved critical bugs under tight deadlines, balancing hands-on Python development with technical leadership.
    - Enforced coding standards through rigorous code reviews and managed the full release and deployment process through to go-live.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Operated as a full-stack developer and de facto technical lead across multiple concurrent projects, owning the full delivery lifecycle, from requirements gathering through deployment and post-launch support, while leading teams, driving technical design, and mentoring colleagues.
    - Defined functional and non-functional requirements, authored user stories, and broke down work into agile-ready tickets, bridging the gap between stakeholders and engineering.
    - Architected and delivered custom Odoo/OpenERP modules using Python, RML, and QWeb, extending platform capabilities to meet complex client needs.
    - Built robust backend systems with Python, OpenObject, and PostgreSQL, and developed responsive frontends using JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap, and LESS.
    - Designed and integrated RESTful APIs to enable reliable communication across distributed system components.
    - Owned code quality end-to-end: led code reviews, maintained unit test coverage, and coordinated production deployments.
    - Produced user documentation and delivered training sessions that accelerated end-user adoption across client teams.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Odoo · OpenERP · QWeb · RML · JavaScript · LESS (Stylesheet Language) · CSS · Bootstrap · jQuery · REST API

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Launched my engineering career building games and web applications while taking early ownership of mentorship and cross-functional collaboration.
    - Engineered 2D/3D video games in C++ using the Irrlicht and Blitz Basic frameworks, delivering polished, playable products from concept to release.
    - Built and maintained web applications with PHP and Symfony, translating business requirements from system analysts into clean, production-ready code.
    - Led internal C++ training sessions for junior developers, establishing best practices that improved team code consistency and onboarding speed.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · PHP · Irrlicht · Symfony · MySQL · PostgreSQL · Blitz Basic · jQuery · HTML · CSS · JavaScript
